title: Mirror Muse in Ruins
description: A woman entirely covered in mirrored disco tiles stands in a surreal ruined landscape, her body intertwined with green vines and flowers. She raises one arm upward while wearing a flower crown, surrounded by flying green birds, floating disco balls, an ornate mirror, and a large framed painting of a sunlit forest.
prompt: A woman made entirely of reflective silver mirror tiles stands gracefully in an ancient ruined stone environment, her body wrapped in lush green vines and colorful flowers. She wears a crown of pink roses, one arm raised dramatically. Floating disco balls, an ornate mirror, draped fabrics, and two green birds in flight surround her. A large wooden frame contains a glowing forest painting with light rays. Surreal fantasy style with magical glowing particles in the air.
